services.name: Plumbing
services.description: Professional plumbing for kitchens, bathrooms and water lines. Includes leak repair, pipe installation, tap replacement and blocked drain clearing.

services.name: Electrical
services.description: Safe electrical repair for homes and small businesses, from blown sockets to full room lighting upgrades.

services.name: AC Repair
services.description: Split and window AC cleaning, gas refill, installation and fault diagnosis for the hot season.

services.name: Refrigerator Repair
services.description: Fridge and freezer repair including compressor checks, thermostat replacement and gas work.

services.name: Phone Repair
services.description: Mobile phone repair for cracked screens, battery drain, charging faults and water damage assessment.

services.name: Computer Repair
services.description: Laptop and desktop repair, OS setup, virus cleanup and hardware upgrades.

services.name: Car Repair
services.description: On-site car diagnostics, oil change, brake work and battery jump or replacement.

services.name: Cleaning
services.description: Scheduled home cleaning, move-in cleaning and office floor care with trained teams.

services.name: Painting
services.description: Room refresh, full-house painting and exterior weatherproof coats.

services.name: Carpentry
services.description: Custom shelves, door alignment, kitchen fittings and wood repair.

services.name: Construction
services.description: Small construction jobs, wall repair, tiling support and site labour coordination.
